positions.pos: A stronger feeling changes only how a ship part looks, never what it does. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Carries cc-intensity-look over to the ship. Pass: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_inner-vessel1_2026-10-18.md

positions.pos: The move you work sets a part's element, the same way it sets an ember's. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Carries cc-move-sets-element over to the ship. Pass: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_inner-vessel1_2026-10-18.md

positions.pos: Finishing any route (a 321, a WAVE run, a preset, a symbol or a fiction) gives one ember, and you choose what kind of part it becomes. No practice is the only door to a part. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Disclosure is not progression currency (QUICKSTART); presets are the floor (cc-charge-only); 321 stays skippable (bmt-321-offer). Architect, Shaman and Regent dissent: they wanted the practice to set the kind. Pass: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_inner-vessel1_2026-10-18.md

positions.pos: The 321 bonus diamond for a big charge drop does not carry over to ship parts. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: It pays for a reported shift, which QUICKSTART rules out as currency. Pass: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_inner-vessel1_2026-10-18.md

positions.pos: A daemon is never a ship part, a target or loot. An honored daemon may ride along as a passenger if you invite it. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: dmt-trainer: the daemon is never fought. Pass: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_inner-vessel1_2026-10-18.md

positions.pos: Nothing on your own ship or in your own world decays while you are away. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: rc-stale-neglect governs shared space only. Pass: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_inner-vessel1_2026-10-18.md

positions.pos: The ship has no fuel gauge and no damage that reflects how much inner work you did. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: The Shaman's standing test: a dim cabin or 'repair needed' says something is wrong with the player. Pass: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_inner-vessel1_2026-10-18.md

positions.pos: Every part remembers the practice, move, date and your own label. If the source is deleted, the part keeps a tombstone and still works. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: QUICKSTART principle 11 (lineage) and its deletion rule. Pass: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_inner-vessel1_2026-10-18.md

positions.pos: Before the Chapter 1 demo the ship travels only the places already built: WAVE room, hall of doors, cave. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: element-settings.md: element lands come after the demo. Pass: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_inner-vessel1_2026-10-18.md

positions.pos: Ship code lives on the single-player cave line in bars-engine, not in the shared Between. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: cc-pouch-private and cc-lantern-offer: shared use waits for offer-and-yes. Pass: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_inner-vessel1_2026-10-18.md

positions.pos: Ship art is our own work or CC0 (Kenney Space Kit qualifies), and no Gummi or Starcruiser name ships. This stands unless you flip it.
'Starship cruiser' was read as Star Wars: Galactic Starcruiser, Disney's two-night immersive voyage. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: A council assumption; flip it if you meant another. Pass: council/passes/6FACE_PASS_inner-vessel1_2026-10-18.md

questions.q: When you picture the ship, what is it?
questions.why_you: It is a matter of your taste, and a living ship adds a character to your canon. The faces split.
questions.not_before: No pass had raised a ship until your message of 2026-10-18.

options.label: A. A craft you build and fly
options.c: Gummi-style editor on a grid; you can compost it. Highest editor risk (KH1's garage drove players off).

options.label: B. A home that moves (recommended)
options.c: The WAVE room carries you, with a small grid of parts inside it. Reuses the room you already have; the Challenger's line.

options.label: C. Living kin
options.c: It speaks and grows with you like No Man's Sky's Living Ship. Adds a new character and voice to write.

questions.q: Do ship parts lift your 'Between only' rule for crafting?
questions.why_you: cc-between-only is your own ruling from today, and a private ship crafts outside the Between.
questions.not_before: No pass had raised a ship until your message of 2026-10-18.

options.label: A. Lift it for the private ship (recommended)
options.c: Embers can become ship parts, under their own permission record. The Between's rules stay as they are.

options.label: B. Keep it
options.c: Ship parts wait until crafting leaves the Between.

questions.q: Does the ship slice run beside the Chapter 1 demo or after it?
questions.why_you: Where it sits against the Kickstarter is a money call, which is yours.
questions.not_before: No pass had raised a ship until your message of 2026-10-18.

options.label: A. After the demo (recommended)
options.c: Design only now; nothing delays the demo. A build thread opens after your phone play.

options.label: B. A WAVE-room dock in the demo
options.c: A fresh thread builds the data model and a dock now; it adds work to the demo path.
